projected_candidate.test_command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_proposed_projected_feedback.py tests/test_proposed_average.py tests/test_proposed_unknown_phase.py tests/test_proposed_iterative_phase.py tests/test_full_score_stopping.py
projected_candidate.scope: Algebra, covariance/mean binding, original classifier features, routing, original phase and stopping; independent Monte Carlo confirmation is separate

projected_energy_candidate.test_command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_proposed_projected_energy.py tests/test_proposed_projected_feedback.py tests/test_proposed_average.py tests/test_proposed_unknown_phase.py tests/test_proposed_iterative_phase.py tests/test_full_score_stopping.py
projected_energy_candidate.scope: Original inference unchanged; public noise scale, two-condition final decision, registry routing and complete unmasked channel outputs verified.

interpretation.uncertainty: 10,000 paired scene bootstrap draws; small-sample intervals are descriptive. Zero observed errors do not imply zero population error.
interpretation.nmse: Total complete-channel error energy / total true active-channel energy; inactive energy included; no final decision mask.
interpretation.readout: Final energy rule changes only activity_decision. probabilities remain the original classifier values; activity_score is not a probability.
interpretation.selection: The old ten scenes and eight development scenes informed the final rule. Only the twenty new scenes are confirmation. No threshold is fitted here.
interpretation.limitations: Estimated local basis, Gaussian scalar covariance approximation and original classifier evidence are approximate; remaining misses and regressions are retained.
interpretation.timing: Concurrent MPS workloads affect wall time; compare first-network call counts. Final energy readout adds no network calls.
